notes.title: Patch notes for Aug 26th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34635094/be480e2214f03f4f790a6268db83b5f5a41fcec6.jpg[/img]
We've just updated the game with an incremental patch. Based on community feedback, we've fixed/added the following :-

- Adjusted maximum upwards aiming angle, you're now able to aim significantly higher than before
- Added a new Audio tab to the options menu, allowing adjustment of music and SFX volume
- Tweaked lighting and colors on the Quantum Cores and Batteries in the OKT areas, making them easier to see if they've been activated or not.

These are relatively minor/quick fixes, but please be assured we are also tackling bigger issues and features for future patches. Thank you for supporting the game!

notes.title: Patch Notes for Aug 21
notes.content: - Fixed critical softblock bug where backtracking to Install without certain abilities means you can't get back to the portal. Have re-enabled the original Installation button for players to escape.

notes.title: Update Notes for 20th Aug
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34635094/be480e2214f03f4f790a6268db83b5f5a41fcec6.jpg[/img]

[u]New Features[/u]
- Added options for camera sensitivity and smoothing for both regular gameplay and aiming.
- Added option to disable controller vibration.
- Added option to invert X axis.
- Added option to change aiming technique curve from Dual Zone to Linear.
- Arrow keys can now switch tabs on the Pause/Options screen.

[u]Fixes[/u]
- Fixed various minor localization issues
- Fixed various minor dynamic music issues in all biomes
